mutant.original: 'Your internet works, but our service cannot be reached from your network. A firewall or VPN may be blocking it.'
mutant.lineText: if (o.service === 'unreachable') return { who: 'you', say: 'Your internet works, but our service cannot be reached from your network. A firewall or VPN may be blocking it.' };
mutant.prevText: if (o.service === 'down' || o.service === 'degraded') return { who: 'us', say: `It is us, not you${o.incident ? `: ${o.incident}` : ''}. We are working on it; you do not need to do anything.` };
mutant.nextText: return { who: 'nobody', say: 'Everything looks fine on our side and yours. Try reloading the page; if it still fails, report the problem and we will look.' };
